description: This file defines the 'ElseIf' class, which implements the <else-if> element for a mini-language used in Apache OFBiz. It handles conditional logic, including parsing XML elements, evaluating conditions, and executing sub-operations.

classes.name: ElseIf
classes.description: Represents the <else-if> element in the mini-language, encapsulating condition evaluation and execution of associated sub-operations.

methods.name: ElseIf
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ElseIf object by parsing XML element and validating child elements, setting up condition and sub-operations.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates the condition in the given method context.

methods.name: getThenSubOps
methods.description: Returns the list of sub-operations to execute if condition is true.

methods.name: runSubOps
methods.description: Executes the sub-operations if the condition evaluates to true.
